# `morphir desktop`

- **Usage:** `morphir desktop [--wait] [--offline] [PATH]`

Launch the installed Morphir Desktop application

## Arguments
- **`[PATH]`** — Workspace directory or Morphir artifact to open (defaults to the current directory)

## Flags
- **`--wait`** — Wait for Desktop to exit and return its exit status
- **`--offline`** — Prohibit acquisition and launch only an already-installed release
